description: Check notification copy. Give `notifications`, one per line as 'title | body' with an optional channel prefix (push:, email:, inapp:, sms:), and `channel` for the default (push). For email, title is the subject and body the preheader; for sms the whole line is the message. Flags: missing title or body, length beyond approximate truncation (push 45/110, email 50/100, in-app 60/140, SMS 160) with a preview of what stays visible, generic text, urgency language, all capitals, exclamation marks, emoji, no specific name, number or time, greeting openers, label prefixes, title repeating body. Truncation varies by device; the numbers are approximate.

channel.description: Default channel: push, email, inapp or sms

notifications.description: One per line: 'title | body', optional channel prefix

name: notification_copy_check
title: Notification copy
